info.about: What is being bought and from what kind of merchant. This sets the reward category, for example a vehicle bought from a dealer.
info.ask: What exactly are you buying, and from what kind of seller?

info.about: Whether the customer already holds a Rho-Bank credit card. New-customer promos and fee waivers apply only to new customers.
info.ask: Do you currently have any Rho-Bank credit cards?

info.about: Full legal name the customer gives on the application
info.ask: What is your full name for the application?

steps.do: Greet the customer and confirm they want a new business credit card that gives the most money back on one large purchase. Ask for purchase_amount, purchase_type, business_type and existing_rho_bank_credit_cards if they have not said them. Identity verification is not needed for a recommendation because no records are looked up; verify (2 of DOB, email, phone, address, then log_verification) only if you must open the customer's records.
steps.quote: Every Rho-Bank credit card earns rewards on all purchases, but certain categories of spending may earn you bonus rewards at a higher rate.

steps.do: Get the current date to check each promo window
steps.quote: This offer is available from 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31.

steps.do: Decide which reward category the purchase falls in for each card. A vehicle purchase is not listed as travel, software, media, operations or sustainable, so it earns each card's default rate unless a document says otherwise.
steps.quote: Purchases in non-bonus categories earn the card’s default rate.

steps.do: Business Bronze Rewards Card: purchase × 1.0%, plus a $500 statement credit if the account opens within 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31 and net purchases reach $10,000 within 2 months. Annual fee is $0.00.
steps.quote: Make net new purchases totaling $10,000 within the first 2 months of account opening.

steps.do: Business Silver Rewards Card: purchase × 1.0% (non travel/software), doubled only if the account opens within 2024-11-14 to 2025-11-14. Annual fee is $122.50, or 0 in the first year if the account opens within 2025-11-15 to 2026-01-15.
steps.quote: New Business Silver Rewards Card customers can earn 2x cash back on all purchases for the first 6 months after opening their account.

steps.do: Business Gold Rewards Card: purchase × 1.0% (a vehicle is not listed as operations spend). Annual fee is $200.00.
steps.quote: Purchases that do not qualify as operations spend earn cash back at 1.0%.

steps.do: Business Platinum Rewards Card: purchase × 1.5% (non travel/software/media). Annual fee is $450.00, or 0 in the first year if the account opens within 2025-11-01 to 2026-02-28.
Green Rewards Card: purchase × 1.0% (not a sustainable merchant). Annual fee is $100.00.
steps.quote: Purchases at qualifying sustainable merchants earn 3.0%, while all other eligible purchases earn 1.0%.

steps.do: Silver Zoom Card: purchase × 1.0% (or 3.0% for transportation/logistics). Multiply by 3 only if the triple promo can still be claimed (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31). Annual fee is $74.50. Consider this card only if the customer's business is a transportation/logistics operator.
steps.quote: All other eligible purchases earn 3 × 1.0% during the promo period

steps.do: Compare the totals: cash back (rounded down to whole points, 1 point = $0.01) plus any promo credit, with the annual fee shown. Recommend exactly one card and state its cash back, its promo amount and the total.
steps.quote: All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number.

steps.do: Confirm the customer's understanding of the total return. Tell them any condition, such as meeting the promo spend within the window or claiming a promo in the portal.
steps.if: customer asks to confirm the expected return
steps.quote: Plan larger purchases early in the period so they post within 2 months.

steps.do: Customer applies for the recommended card

args.card_type: the recommended card's exact name, e.g. 'Business Bronze Rewards Card'

rules.rule: Business Bronze Rewards Card earns 1.0% on eligible purchases.
rules.quote: You earn 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases charged to your account.

rules.rule: Business Bronze new-customer promo gives a $500 statement credit when the account opens within 2025-10-01 to 2026-03-31 and net purchases reach $10,000 within the first 2 months.
rules.quote: After qualification, a $500 statement credit will be applied to your account.
You are not charged an annual membership fee; the annual fee is $0.00.

rules.rule: Business Silver earns 1.0% on purchases outside travel and software.
rules.quote: Earn 1.0% cash back on all other purchases

rules.rule: The Business Silver 2x promo applies only to accounts opened within 2024-11-14 to 2025-11-14.
rules.quote: You must open your account during the promotional period to qualify

rules.rule: Business Silver annual fee is $122.50; the first year is 0 for accounts opened within 2025-11-15 to 2026-01-15.
rules.quote: New customers who open an account during the promotional window receive a first-year annual fee of 0
The annual fee for the Business Gold Rewards Card is $200.00.

rules.rule: Business Platinum standard annual fee is $450.00; the first year is 0 only within 2025-11-01 to 2026-02-28.
rules.quote: After the first year, the standard annual fee applies: $450.00

rules.rule: Business Platinum minimum approved credit limit is $75,000.
Silver Zoom is built for transportation/logistics operators and charges a $74.50 annual fee.
rules.quote: Established transportation and logistics operators that can meet both personal and business credit criteria

rules.rule: The Silver Zoom triple cash back promo must be claimed between 2024-01-01 and 2025-12-31; no claims are accepted after that.
rules.quote: You must claim the promotion within the window starting 2024-01-01 and ending 2025-12-31

rules.rule: Green Rewards Card annual fee is $100.00 and non-sustainable purchases earn 1.0%.
Cash back points convert at 1 point = $0.01.
rules.quote: these 'points' should be interpreted as cash back with a conversion rate of 1 point = $0.01

rules.rule: Business Bronze initial credit line is between $10,000 and $50,000.
rules.quote: Your initial credit line will be at least $10,000 and may be as high as $50,000 based on underwriting.

jobs.done_when: The agent has recommended exactly one business card and shown its cash back, any promo credit and the total for the purchase (with promo conditions and the annual fee), and the customer has applied for that card with apply_for_credit_card or declined.

open_questions: No document says which reward category a vehicle purchase from a dealer falls under. 'Transportation' is described as logistics, shipping, rideshare, transit, parking and tolls, not vehicle purchases, so the default rate is assumed.
No document says whether the annual fee should be subtracted when ranking cards by 'most money back'. Show the fee alongside the total.
No document says whether a non-logistics business (e.g. landscaping) qualifies for the Silver Zoom Card.
Initial credit lines (e.g. Business Bronze at least $10,000, up to $50,000) may be lower than the purchase amount. No document says how to handle this before applying.
There is no internal procedure for card recommendations or applications, and none says whether identity verification is needed before the customer runs apply_for_credit_card.
